description: This source file contains an implementation class 'ShareAccountSchedularServiceImpl' that handles the scheduling and processing of share account dividend posting functionality within the financing software. It interacts with repositories and domain services to post dividends for share accounts, updating dividend status and recording transactions.

classes.name: ShareAccountSchedularServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ShareAccountSchedularService interface responsible for posting dividends to share accounts, updating dividend status, and recording transactions in the database.

methods.name: postDividend
methods.description: Handles the posting of a dividend for a specific share account dividend detail and associated savings account by updating transaction status and dividend record.
